issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'God speaks in one [way], and in two [ways] one does not perceive it' — the subject of 'không chịu để ý' (does not pay attention) is 'loài người' (mankind), which is an addition not present in the Hebrew; the Hebrew has no explicit subject for 'không nhận biết' (not perceive), and the verse is about not perceiving God's speech, not about mankind refusing to pay attention.
